words: Hi Sofia,
That's wonderful news — congratulations!
It was great to get your message, and I honestly haven't stopped smiling since I read it.
You worked so hard for this, and nobody deserves it more.

Honestly, being nervous is completely normal; I felt exactly the same before I left, and so did everyone I met out there.

I am writing with reference to your advertisement for the position of weekend receptionist, which I saw on your centre's website last week.
I am interested in applying for the post because I have always enjoyed working with people in an active environment.

words: Dear Sir or Madam,
I am writing to express my strong dissatisfaction with my recent stay at your hotel from 3 to 6 July.
Unfortunately, the accommodation did not match the standard advertised on your website.
rounds.note: From a model email. It opens: it sets the scene or says why you are writing.

words: If I were you, I'd definitely focus on the first two weeks and nothing beyond that.
From my own experience, saying yes to everything at the start is really worth it, even when you're tired.
I think you should also join one club in the first month — that's where I met most of my friends.
rounds.note: From a model email. It develops a point: details, reasons, examples.

words: I have experience working with the public, as I spent last summer on the reception desk of a small hotel.
My duties included greeting guests, answering the telephone and managing bookings, which helped me develop strong organisational skills.
Furthermore, I am a motivated and reliable person who works well under pressure, and I speak both English and Portuguese fluently.
rounds.note: From a model email. It develops a point: details, reasons, examples.

words: As a result, my family and I slept very badly in temperatures of over thirty degrees, and the children were extremely disappointed.
What should have been a relaxing holiday became a genuinely uncomfortable one.
I would therefore like to request a partial refund, or at the very least a substantial discount on a future booking.
rounds.note: From a model email. It develops a point: details, reasons, examples.

words: Firstly, I was extremely disappointed with the room, which was considerably smaller than the photographs suggested and had not been properly cleaned.
Secondly, my other complaint is about the air conditioning, which did not work at all despite two calls to reception.
Thirdly, I was shocked to find that the swimming pool, one of the main reasons I chose your hotel, was closed for the entire week.
rounds.note: From a model email. It develops a point: details, reasons, examples.

words: I'd really like to make it up to you.
How about I take you out for dinner next weekend, just the two of us?
Or if the exhibition is still on, I'd love you to show me round it properly.
rounds.note: From a model email. It develops a point: details, reasons, examples.

words: What happened was that my train was cancelled at the last minute, and the next one wasn't for another two hours.
I tried to call you, but my phone had died and I couldn't find anywhere to charge it.
I know that's not really an excuse — I should have set off much earlier.
rounds.note: From a model email. It develops a point: details, reasons, examples.

words: Here's what I'm thinking.
We could meet at the station at around nine and take the 9:20 train to Sintra, which gets in just before ten.
That would give us the morning for the palace and the afternoon for the old town, with lunch at that little place near the square.
There's a lovely walk through the woods afterwards if we still have the energy.
rounds.note: From a model email. It develops a point: details, reasons, examples.

words: The plan is fairly relaxed.
On the Saturday we're walking along the coast in the morning and then having a barbecue at my parents' place in the afternoon.
I think you'd really enjoy the evening — a few people are bringing guitars, so it will probably turn into a singalong.
rounds.note: From a model email. It develops a point: details, reasons, examples.

words: We absolutely have to celebrate before you go.
Why don't we go out for dinner at that Italian place you love, and then meet the others afterwards?
If you'd rather keep it small, we could always do something at mine instead.
Either way, dinner is on me — you're not allowed to argue about that.
rounds.note: From a model email. It develops a point: details, reasons, examples.

words: If you'd rather do something less touristy, we could go to the coast instead and walk from Cascais.
If Saturday doesn't work we could always move it to the Sunday — I'm free either day.
What do you reckon?
